title: How do you check where your PnL actually comes from?
author: mahabub129
selftext:
Disclosure: I create content for Bitget, so I'm not neutral about the tool below.

Watching the chart is a weak way to judge a trading day. The asset that moved the most isn't always the one that moved your account. A smaller leveraged position, a running bot, or fees can matter more.

Bitget's Asset Daily Report splits yesterday's PnL across spot, futures, bots, and earn, and flags your Top Contributor and Biggest Drag with a short AI explanation. It also shows liquidations, open interest, and stablecoin market cap next to your results. GetAgent lets you ask follow-up questions about the breakdown. Eligible VIP users get personalised position analysis, and regular users get one free trial.

Where to find it: Bitget App, Assets, Unified Account, Overview, Asset Daily Report.
